_comment: Module 5 Bus Scheduling and Route Optimization Configuration. All parameters labeled ASSUMPTION are engineering models and NOT official DTC operational rules.

turnaround_and_recovery.description: ASSUMPTION — NOT FROM DTC DATA: Mandatory buffer between consecutive trips for vehicle turnaround, passenger clearance, and driver rest.

duty_duration_constraints.description: ASSUMPTION — NOT FROM DTC DATA: Maximum single-shift elapsed vehicle duty duration (from first trip start to last trip end).
duty_duration_constraints.description_continuous: ASSUMPTION — NOT FROM DTC DATA: Maximum continuous driving duration without minimum 30-minute layover break.

deadhead_repositioning.description: ASSUMPTION — NOT FROM DTC DATA: Assumed average empty bus deadhead speed between different terminal stops across Delhi.
deadhead_repositioning.description_distance: ASSUMPTION — NOT FROM DTC DATA: Maximum allowable empty deadhead repositioning distance between trip endpoints for trip linking.

headway_and_service_window.description: ASSUMPTION — NOT FROM DTC DATA: Operational service boundaries and standard urban headway ranges.

ml_runtime_uncertainty.description: ASSUMPTION — NOT FROM DTC DATA: Safety multiplier applied to ML segment runtime predictions to account for stochastic traffic delay (e.g. 1.05 = 5% buffer).
